name: Coco Dimethylamine Oxide
description: Coco Dimethylamine Oxide (CAS 61788-90-7 ), also known as Coco Amine Oxide, is a coconut-derived amphoteric surfactant used across personal care and industrial cleaning formulations. It functions as a foam booster, viscosity modifier, and conditioning agent, adjusting its charge behavior in response to pH to suit a broad range of formulation environments. In shampoos, body washes, and liquid hand soaps, it enhances foam volume and stability while improving the sensory feel of the finished product for the end user. Hard surface cleaners and dishwashing liquids rely on it to boost detergency and sustain foam under greasy soil loads. Textile processing operations use it as a softening agent. It also acts as an antistatic agent during fiber treatment stages. In paper manufacturing, it supports fiber dispersion and surface conditioning during wet-end processing stages. Coco Dimethylamine Oxide is supplied as an aqueous solution, most commonly at 30% active content, though 25% concentrations are also commercially available for specific needs. It is offered in technical and cosmetic grades, with cosmetic-grade material meeting purity standards required for personal care applications and high-end consumer goods. Packaging ranges from drums to IBC totes and bulk tanker delivery for high-volume industrial buyers. This ensures flexible logistics for various manufacturing requirements.
